你是外贸合规审核员。下面给你一段待发布的文本，以及一组规则（每条有编号、规则原文摘录和要判断的问题）。

只根据给出的规则判断。另外会给你工厂与产品资料，用来核对待审文本里的价格、条款、材料、认证等事实；资料本身不是待审对象。
如果待审文本与资料一致、也符合规则，就不要报。对每一个问题：
- 必须写 `rule_id`：只能是下面列出的规则编号之一。
- 必须写 `quote`：从待审文本里逐字复制出有问题的那一小段（不超过 20 个词）。
- 写不出规则编号或原文片段的问题，不要输出。宁可漏报，不要编造。
- severity：red = 明确违反规则；amber = 有风险、需要人确认。
- problem_zh / suggestion_zh 用简体中文，suggestion 给出具体改法。

只输出 JSON：
{"findings": [{"rule_id": "...", "quote": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "problem_zh": "...", "suggestion_zh": "..."}]}
如果没有问题：{"findings": []}

## 平台
阿里巴巴国际站 · RFQ 回复

## 规则
[
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-01",
  "title_zh": "产品属性必须与实物一致",
  "excerpt": "Product attributes must be consistent with the actual condition of the product, and accurately showing the ingredients, materials, sizes, brands, models, places of origin",
  "question_zh": "回复或文案里的材质、尺寸、型号、产地等属性是否与已知产品资料一致（例如是否把塑料手柄/盖子的水壶说成全不锈钢）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-02",
  "title_zh": "付款与发货条件须符合真实能力",
  "excerpt": "Payment and shipping options must be consistent with the actual service capability of suppliers.",
  "question_zh": "回复中承诺的起订量、交期、港口、付款方式或单价，是否都有供应商提供的资料支撑，而不是模型自己编的？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-03",
  "title_zh": "发布的信息须真实、准确、合法",
  "excerpt": "Member should ensure that all information you post on the Sites is true, accurate and lawful and should not be false or misleading",
  "question_zh": "回复中是否有无法由产品资料证实、可能虚假或误导买家的说法（例如未提供证书却声称已获某认证）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-01",
  "title_zh": "FOB / FAS 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both apply only to sea or inland waterway transport (i.e. port-to-to port shipments).",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在空运、快递或陆运场景下使用了 FOB/FAS/CFR/CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-02",
  "title_zh": "集装箱货物更适合用 FCA",
  "excerpt": "FCA (Free Carrier) is the more appropriate Incoterms® rule.",
  "question_zh": "整柜或拼柜的集装箱报价用了 FOB 时，回复是否提示 FCA 可能更合适（可以作为可选项，不要求替换）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-03",
  "title_zh": "FOB：装上买方指定船只即完成交货，风险同时转移",
  "excerpt": "the seller delivers the goods loaded on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复对 FOB 的解释（谁订船、谁付运费、风险何时转移）是否与“装上买方指定船只即交货、风险转移”一致？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-04",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both Incoterms® CIF and Incoterms® CFR are used for sea or inland waterway transportation only.",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在非海运场景下报了 CFR 或 CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-05",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 风险在装运港装船时转移",
  "excerpt": "risk of loss of or damage to the goods transfers when the goods are placed on board the vessel at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复是否错误地表示 CFR/CIF 下卖方要承担运输途中直到目的港的风险？"
 }
]

## 工厂与产品资料（只用来核对事实，不是待审文本）

## 待审文本（按字段）
{
 "reply": "Dear Dana,\n\nThank you for your inquiry and for considering us for your hotel group's guest-room garment steamer project. A rollout of about 3,200 units across 40 properties is the kind of hospitality order we handle well, and we would be glad to support you from samples through both Q1 deliveries.\n\n1. Quotation (FOB Ningbo, by sea)\n- Model: [Model No.], [handheld / standing] garment steamer, 120V/60Hz, US plug, [wattage]W\n- Unit price: USD [X.XX]/unit for 3,000+ units\n- Packing: [units per carton], carton size [L x W x H cm], [units per 20GP/40HQ container]\n- Production lead time: [XX] days after L/C receipt and sample approval\n- Price validity: [XX] days\n\nFor 3,200 units in two lots, we suggest about [1,600] units per lot, or a split that matches your property opening schedule. Please share your target arrival dates in Florida and your preferred port of discharge (for example, Jacksonville, Miami or Port Everglades), and we will plan production and shipping to meet them.\n\n2. Certification\n[Option A: This model is ETL/UL listed under file No. [XXXX]. We will send the certificate with the samples and can share it by email beforehand.]\n[Option B: This model is currently not ETL/UL listed. We can arrange ETL certification for your order, which takes about [X] weeks and costs about USD [X]. We can also recommend a comparable model that is already certified. Please let us know which you prefer.]\n\n3. Payment\nWe accept L/C at sight. Please send us your draft L/C terms in advance so we can confirm the documentary requirements and avoid any discrepancies.\n\n4. Samples\nWe will be happy to send 2 samples to your Orlando office. [The samples are free of charge, and we will cover express shipping.] / [The sample cost is USD [X], refundable against your bulk order, and courier freight is about USD [X], or you may provide your courier account.] Please confirm your full delivery address, recipient name and phone number. We can dispatch within [X] working days of confirmation.\n\n5. Hotel-specific options\nWe can also offer:\n- Automatic shut-off and anti-dry-boil protection for guest safety\n- Custom logo and branded gift box\n- Wall-mount bracket or storage bag for in-room placement\n- Spare parts and a [X]-year warranty with replacement support\n\nTo finalize the offer, could you tell us whether you prefer a handheld or standing unit, whether you need custom branding, and the target delivery date for each lot?\n\nWe look forward to working with you and your properties.\n\nBest regards,\n[Your Name]\n[Title] | [Company Name]\nEmail: [email] | WhatsApp/Tel: [number]\n[Website]"
}
